title: UneceAgriculturalCharacteristic
description: A prominent attribute or aspect of an agricultural object.

agriculturalCharacteristicValueCode.description: The code specifying the value of this agricultural characteristic.

description.description: The textual description of this agricultural characteristic.

identifier.description: The identifier for this agricultural characteristic.

typeCode.description: The code specifying the type of agricultural characteristic.

value.description: The value, expressed as text, for this agricultural characteristic.

valueAmount.description: The value, expressed as an amount, for this agricultural characteristic.

valueDateTime.description: The value, expressed as a date, time, date time, or other date time value, of this agricultural characteristic.

valueIndicator.description: The value, expressed as an indicator, for this agricultural characteristic.

valueMeasure.description: The measure of a value for this agricultural characteristic.

valueMethod.description: A method specified for the value of this agricultural characteristic.

valueNumeric.description: The value, expressed as a number, for this agricultural characteristic.

valueParameter.description: A parameter specified for the value of this agricultural characteristic.

valueRange.description: A range specified for the value of this agricultural characteristic.

valueTolerance.description: A tolerance specified for the value of this agricultural characteristic.
